title: Family Safety Capability and Policy Foundation
objective: Implement the bounded Family Safety Capability and Policy Foundation tranche after completed_verified MIB-16 using the approved MIB-17 deliverables and completion gate.

scope.purpose: Prepare Multiversal-controlled child/family protections before platform-specific parental APIs exist.
deliverables: capability taxonomy for invitations, communication, community/public content, mature-content exposure, AI assistance, purchases/commerce hooks, external links and other Multiversal-controlled surfaces
guardian authority explicitly separate from GM/Campaign/private-creator authority
age-band/profile metadata without pretending to implement unavailable platform controls
test matrix for bypass/cross-context authority leakage
scope.completion_gate: Product-controlled capabilities can be deterministically policy-gated without granting guardians unintended access to private creative or Campaign-hidden content.

selection_boundaries: MIB-17 application proof is merged and exact-head validated on Linux, Windows, and deterministic cross-platform comparison.
Guardian authority remains separate from GM, Campaign-hidden, private-creator, canonical and mechanical authority.
Platform-specific parental APIs, unavailable platform controls, paid providers and production deployment remain outside MIB-17 completion claims.
MIB-17 implementation authority is retired after this completed_verified checkpoint.
MIB-18 is selected_not_started only; no MIB-18 implementation branch or authority exists.
next_action: MIB-18 is the strict selected_not_started successor. On the next owner Continue, governed-start MIB-18 and grant bounded implementation authority only after canonical state is reconciled.

execution_conformance.execution_quality_note: The first post-OPS3 product tranche exposed and repaired snapshot-coupled control-plane assertions before and during transition; the final product implementation passed the governed cross-platform Validation Core and merged with identical validated tree content.
